beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A proof can be valid while the claim made about reality remains unjustified.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Outfinite Mathematics starts from the boundaries that separate those two achievements.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This book proposes a research programme for keeping such distinctions visible to machines.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It connects mathematical foundations, formal analysis, scientific evidence, and artificial intelligence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its central promise is a more explicit account of what each result actually establishes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The programme is presented as a candidate to test, not an accomplished replacement mathematics.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers encounter both proposed structures and conditions under which those structures should fail.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That combination of ambition and falsifiability gives the book its particular character.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Mathematics gains power by studying ideal objects without manufacturing their physical realizations.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book preserves that achievement while questioning what happens during application.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A real number in a theory differs from a finite stored representation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A simulation differs from the physical process it is intended to describe.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Human specialists often carry these distinctions through context and practical experience.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Machine-mediated science makes their implicit status harder to ignore.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposed foundation would represent limits and justified transitions as part of the knowledge.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Reading the opening chapters explains why this is more than attaching cautionary notes.
